hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Lower master valve
function: The barrier valve at the bottom of the tree, left open in service and closed only when the tree above it needs work.

tabs.overview: Manual gate valve; not cycled under flow so the seats stay unworn for the day it must hold.
tabs.engineering: API 6A; same rating as the tree.
tabs.safety: Cycled only with the well shut in on the upper master.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
